name: SVO Node Visualization via Instanced Cubes
definition: A compute-to-draw pipeline that converts SVO nodes into instanced cubes for visualization. A compute shader (mVisualCS) populates a VisualPackage buffer and an atomic counter, which is then used to render instanced cubes via indexed draw calls.
summary: SVO Node Visualization via Instanced Cubes renders Sparse Voxel Octree nodes as instanced cubes using a compute shader to generate instance data, differing from SSBO-based methods by explicitly creating positions and sizes from node metadata.
